moments.text: Colour daylight view down on bare desert ridges and a dark ravine. A tiny dark dot crosses from right of the crosshair to the upper-left edge.
The camera swings quickly across the slopes, then the picture goes black for a moment.
The view widens to rippled ridges and a winding gully and holds steady.
After a blank grey frame the camera zooms in; the tiny dark dot reappears left of the crosshair as the camera pans.
The dark dot moves left to right above and left of the crosshair, across a pale slope.
The dark dot drifts down and to the right through the lower right of the frame as the camera pans.
After a black frame the colours turn brownish; the dark dot shows below and right of the crosshair, sinking toward the bottom edge.
Normal colours return and the camera swings back out to the wide view of desert ridges.
The view zooms in on a dark ravine bend between pale ridges and stays on it to the end as the colours turn bluish.

notes: Object is a few-pixel dark dot in a daylight colour video; often hard to see between the listed passes.
